# The definition of "required for merge" for vidra-search.
#
# scripts/ci/require-checks.sh reads this file in the `ci-required` job and
# fails unless every entry is satisfied for the commit under test. Configure
# ONE required status check in branch protection — `ci-required` — and this
# file becomes the single place the required set is declared and reviewed.
# TWIN: vidra-core .github/required-checks.txt — same syntax, same job.
#
# Syntax (one check-run name per line, i.e. a job's name as GitHub reports it):
#   name    must EXIST for this commit and must conclude `success`
#   ?name   required only IF it ran (path-filtered lanes)
#
# Nothing but `success` passes: `cancelled`, `timed_out`, `neutral` and
# `skipped` all fail.

# search-ci.yml — the canonical `make ci` gate + exact module manifest.
build-test

# search-integration.yml — `-tags=integration` against real Postgres + Redis,
# with the no-silent-skip audit over its verbose log.
integration

# openapi.yml — spec lint + route/spec drift guard.
openapi

# ci-guard.yml — action pins, no hidden continue-on-error, search-ci really runs
# `make ci`, required-checks.txt names only jobs that exist. Path-filtered to
# .github/workflows/**.
?guard

# rollback-floor.yml — the PREVIOUS release's migrator against this schema.
# Path-filtered to migrations/, internal/dbmigrate/ and cmd/api/migrate.go.
?prev-migrator-against-new-schema

# training-ci.yml — offline LightGBM pipeline on synthetic data, and the
# feature-order contract with internal/ranking.ModelFeatureNames. Path-filtered
# to training/**, so required exactly when the pipeline changed.
?smoke

# NOT required, deliberately:
#   publish    release-triggered image build, not a PR gate
